en: The consciousness-ether [is the subject] for the hymn to the illustrious Naṭarāja.
Salutations to you, O Rudra, for your wrath, and also for your arrow;
salutations be to you for your bow, and salutations, salutations to your two hands. 1.
O Rudra, that form of yours which is auspicious and peaceful—to that we offer salutation after salutation.
Homage be to the blue-necked one; homage to you, the thousand-eyed one. || 2 ||
Salutation to you, the thousand-armed one; salutation to you, the most bountiful.
Salutation to you, the one with matted hair; salutation to you, whose form is Time. || 3 ||
Salutations to you who hold a sword; salutations to you who carry a trident in your hand.
Homage to you, the golden-handed one, and to you, the lord of gold. 4.
Salutations to you who have the form of a tree; salutations to you with golden hair.
Salutations to you, the Lord of animals, and salutations to you, the Lord of paths. || 5 ||
Salutations to you, the Lord of the nourished; salutations to the Lord of the fields.
Salutations to the Lord of the forests, whose nature is that of the archer.
Salutation to Rohita, the lord of trees;
salutation to you, the manifest counselor, the lord of thickets. || 7 ||
Salutations to the Lord of herbs, the manifest Supreme Self;
salutations to the God of loud sound, the Lord of foot-soldiers. || 8 ||
Salutations to you, the Lord of beings; salutations to the Lord of clouds.
Salutations again and again to the Conqueror, the Peaceful, and the Benefactor. || 9 ||
Salutations to you, the lord of mental anxieties; salutations to you, the lord of diseases.
Salutations to you, the one who dwells in the quarters; salutations be to you, the bearer of the quiver.
Salutations to you, the lord of thieves; salutations to you, the lord of riches.
Salutations to you, the lord of robbers, who removes all sins. (11)
He deceives, he utterly deceives; homage to the lord of thieves!
Homage to you, O Niceru, the lord of the forests! 12.
Homage to you, the one with the uṣṇīṣa; homage to you, the Supreme Self.
Homage to you, the expansive one; repeated homage to you, the seated one. || 13 ||
Salutations to You who are reclining; salutations again and again to You who are in deep sleep.
Salutations to You who are awakened, the steadfast Supreme Self.
Salutations always to you, who possess the assembly and are the Lord of the assembly;
salutations to Śiva with Ambā, the Brahman, the witness of all. || 15 ||
Thus ends the praise of the Lord of the Assembly in the Muktikāṇḍa of the Sūtasamhitā.
